pages: A small town seen from a hillside footpath at half past five on a November evening. Foreground: wet grass, gorse, a concrete kerb. Middle distance: a ring road, dark roofs, two steel pylons with their arms and insulators. Background: the industrial estate as a black block. The last streetlights burn while the town goes out in one sweep.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at a steel desk. Foreground: a row of relay switches. Middle distance: relay cubicles, cable trays, a steel door ajar. Background: a yard light, a pylon. Strip light over the desk.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the steel desk. Foreground: a folded printed plan, four panels. Middle distance: a wall of relay panels, a shelf. Background: a steel door, cable trays. Strip light on the sheet.

Doran, fifty, stocky, a grey beard, a green fleece, at the ops desk. Foreground: a wall telephone, a whiteboard on castors, a mug. Middle distance: the steel desk, the binder, a swivel chair. Background: a relay wall, a door. Strip light, and the whiteboard catching it.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the steel desk. Foreground: a folded plan, four panels, a pencil mark in the third margin, the handset. Middle distance: relay panels, a wall clock. Background: the steel door. Strip light overhead.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the desk with the handset. Foreground: the back of her hand, the time inked on her skin. Middle distance: the folded plan open. Background: relay panels. Lamp and strip light.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the steel desk. Foreground: her palm flat on the folded plan, four panels. Middle distance: the desk, a wall clock. Background: a yard light beyond the door. Strip light on her arm.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the open switchgear cabinet. Foreground: a row of switches, her hand on a lever. Middle distance: the folded plan in one hand, a torch. Background: a substation room, relay panels. Strip light.

The ops room after the last handover. Foreground: a whiteboard on castors, blank, a marker and an eraser on its tray. Middle distance: an empty steel desk, a wall clock, a grey ring binder on the shelf. Background: a row of lit windows on Rennard Row, a yard light. Strip light, and the windows outside.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the desk with the handset. Foreground: the handset in her hand, the folded plan beside it, a pen. Middle distance: the whiteboard. Background: an empty corridor. Strip light, corridor dark.

Halvard, a man of sixty-one, at the far end of a corridor with an untouched cup of coffee. Foreground: the cup, one hand round it and not lifting it. Middle distance: a run of grey doors, a notice board, a fire point. Background: an empty desk and a lit panel beyond. Strip light along the ceiling.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the steel desk with the folded plan. Foreground: the sheet in both hands, an old fold. Middle distance: the open binder, a phone. Background: the whiteboard. Strip light on the sheet.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, drawing on the back of the old sheet. Foreground: a steel ruler, a pencil, columns ruled on the reverse. Middle distance: the binder. Background: the whiteboard. Strip light on the paper.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, in a stairwell. Foreground: insulated gloves on, a tester, a torch, a blank metal housing plate. Middle distance: a concrete landing. Background: a dark block of flats. Torchlight on the plate.

A pumping station compound before first light. Foreground: a switch on a grey board thrown to its new position, a wall clock, a lit fault lamp. Middle distance: a bench, a can of grease, a hard hat. Background: a compound fence, a van, a dark shed. Cold light from one strip fitting.

Doran, fifty, stocky, a grey beard, a green fleece, at the ops desk. Foreground: a telephone handset in his hand, the whiteboard behind him, a mug going cold. Middle distance: a row of clock timers, the steel desk, the binder. Background: the relay wall, the strip light. Desk lamp and strip light.

The ring road from the top of the hill, at nine in the evening. Foreground: a wet carriageway, a kerb, one streetlamp still dark. Middle distance: a row of terraced houses with windows coming on one by one, two vans. Background: the industrial estate, a pylon, a low moon. Street light, and windows going up the row.

Ivy Crane, an old woman of eighty-one, behind a trestle table in a gasworks hall. Foreground: a percolator, a stack of cups, a plate of biscuits. Middle distance: a trestle table, a folding chair, a rack of hats. Background: a hall wall, a lit doorway, a stove. Lamp light on the cups.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the wheel of the van. Foreground: her hands on the wheel, a torch on the seat. Middle distance: a lit stair tower. Background: a block of flats. Street light on the bonnet.

Solveig, a woman of twenty-six, short dark hair cut level with the jaw, in a bright orange insulated coverall with a pen pushed into the left sleeve, at the steel desk. Foreground: two folded sheets side by side, a ruler, a pen. Middle distance: the grey ring binder, a mug. Background: the relay wall, a window. Daylight on the sheets.

A grey ring binder on a shelf above a steel desk, closed. Foreground: a folded plan sheet laid on the desk, creased soft along the folds, a steel ruler across it. Middle distance: the desk, a pen, a wall clock. Background: a relay wall, a window, dust in the light. Afternoon light across the sheet.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, at the top of Tarnby. Foreground: a garden wall and a gate. Middle distance: a row of council houses. Background: the bare hillside and a second empty house higher up. Dusk light, blue and low.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, standing in a bus driver's cab. Foreground: a folded timetable held flat against the wheel, an exercise book, a pencil. Middle distance: the fare box. Background: a wet road. Morning sun through the glass.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, on a shopping street. Foreground: a bare stone fascia above a shop door. Middle distance: a chapel gate, a headstone. Background: the bare hillside. Flat white afternoon light.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, at a kitchen table with a telephone handset. Foreground: a folded page, a notepad, a cold mug. Middle distance: the table, a window. Background: a dark street. A desk lamp throws one circle on it.

A first-floor front room in a council house, empty. Foreground: a stepladder with a paint tray on the top step. Middle distance: a hall stand with one man's coat, a chair with a shawl. Background: through the window, the bare hillside and the second empty house. Flat grey daylight.

Ruslan, a young solicitor of twenty-four, alone at a small table in a one-room office above a shop. Foreground: a laptop open in front of him, a squared folder, a pen down. Middle distance: filing shelves, a radiator, a sash window. Background: a car park with one car. Flat overcast window light.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, standing at a kitchen table. Foreground: a single sheet under her flat hand, a kettle. Middle distance: the worktop, an open back door. Background: a hall and a stair rail. Porch light across the lino.

Martina, an old woman of eighty-one, standing in a kitchen doorway with a cup in one hand. Foreground: the cup, her knuckles on it. Middle distance: the kitchen table with a single sheet, a cold teapot. Background: a hall, a hanging coat. Steam from the kettle crosses the doorway light.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, at a table with four loose sheets. Foreground: her hand on the third page, a pencil, a handset face down. Middle distance: a school hall table. Background: a wet playing field. Wednesday morning light.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, at the shop counter. Foreground: the handset in her hand, a notepad, a Sunday calendar. Middle distance: the counter and a card rack. Background: the shop window, a dark street. A small lamp overhead.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, sitting on the edge of the bath. Foreground: one sheet on her knee. Middle distance: the bath, a folded towel, the tap. Background: tiles, a frosted window. A bathroom strip light, flat and white.

Lorcan Fee, a registrar, at a table with a cloth on it in a room above the library. Foreground: his hands, a folder squared, a pen. Middle distance: a bench, a radiator, a wall clock. Background: a high window, a closed door. Daylight through the window, the clock two minutes fast.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, seated at the table with the cloth. Foreground: her hands flat on the table, a sheet before her. Middle distance: a bench, a radiator. Background: the wall clock, a window. Flat daylight, radiator ticking.

Martina, an old woman of eighty-one, in the second row of benches. Foreground: her hands folded in her lap, a handbag on the floor. Middle distance: the bench back, the radiator. Background: a table with a cloth, a wall clock. Flat daylight from a high window.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, standing with a sheet flat on her open palm. Foreground: her open hand, the wide cuff. Middle distance: the table with a cloth. Background: the wall clock, the radiator. Flat daylight; her eyes stay down.

Martina, an old woman of eighty-one, half risen from a bench. Foreground: one hand on the bench edge, the cardigan sleeve. Middle distance: the bench, the radiator. Background: the table with a cloth, the closed door. Daylight from the high window, cold on her face.

Ema, a girl of nineteen, dark hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, a mustard-yellow wool coat with wide cuffs and dark boots, at a kitchen table with a year's letters. Foreground: a bundle of weekly envelopes, a mug. Middle distance: the table, a clock. Background: a window, a clothes horse. Low early light across the table.

Martina, an old woman of eighty-one, at a kitchen table with the door shut. Foreground: her hands round a cup. Middle distance: the kettle, a cloth on the table, a fruit bowl. Background: a window, a dark garden. One low lamp, the door line shut behind her.

A kitchen drawer pulled open on a lino floor. Foreground: a supermarket carrier bag with a folded sheet inside it, a new pad, a cutlery tray. Middle distance: the drawer runners, a tea towel, a spoon. Background: a dresser, a chair leg. Morning light across the lino from the side.

The ward corridor at Wray Infirmary at night, empty. Foreground: a steel ward desk and a ring of eleven steel chart hooks, one hook empty. Middle distance: eleven beds along one wall, a trolley. Background: a window at the end of the corridor, a dark field. One strip light overhead.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, crouched at the desk. Foreground: the bottom drawer stuck open, spare forms, a box of ties, a pad. Middle distance: the desk, the corridor. Background: a wall of small windows. Her torch beam on the drawer.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at the steel desk. Foreground: an open pad, her pen, the desk lamp. Middle distance: the chart ring, a wall of charts. Background: the corridor, a bed trolley. The desk lamp on the pad.

A forearm on a white sheet under a torch beam. Foreground: an older forearm, fine bright specks of glass in the skin, forceps, a kidney dish, a swab. Middle distance: a bed rail, a folded blanket. Background: a strip light, a window. Torchlight, hard and close.

A staircase in a council house in daylight. Foreground: a new wooden stair rail and two fixing plates. Middle distance: the stairs, a hall runner, a coat hook. Background: a frosted front door, a folded folder and an envelope on the mat. Daylight from a fanlight above.

Bronwen, a midwife in her fifties, coming through the ward double doors in the small hours. Foreground: her bag over one arm, a folded coat, a key in her hand. Middle distance: the corridor, a wall clock, a trolley. Background: an open ward door, a strip light. Night light, hard from above.

Bastien, a man of fifty-eight with a grey moustache, the matron, at the end of the corridor. Foreground: a teapot and two mugs on the windowsill, a folded letter face down. Middle distance: him, leaning on the sill. Background: the end window, the dark field, a strip light. Strip light, and the window black.

Bastien, a man of fifty-eight with a grey moustache, the matron, at the steel desk. Foreground: a four-page letter lying face down between two mugs, his hand flat beside it. Middle distance: the desk, the chart ring, the open bottom drawer. Background: the corridor, the end window. Desk lamp, low and warm.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at a bare table. Foreground: her hands, eleven box files, one pad open. Middle distance: chairs, a shelf of files. Background: a window, a bare wall. A fluorescent tube overhead, colourless.

Bastien, a man of fifty-eight with a grey moustache, the matron, in the ward corridor. Foreground: a pad held flat in both hands, the pages fanned. Middle distance: the strip light, a bay of beds. Background: the end window, the dark field. Strip light overhead, the pad in shadow.

Bastien, a man of fifty-eight with a grey moustache, the matron, at the open bottom drawer. Foreground: the drawer on its runner, two pads inside, one of them worn through. Middle distance: him, the desk, the chart ring. Background: the corridor, the end window. Desk lamp on the drawer.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at the chart ring. Foreground: a fresh chart on a hook, her pen and hand. Middle distance: eleven hooks, one chart lifted out. Background: the desk, the corridor. The desk lamp on the paper.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at a small ward table. Foreground: a sealed envelope, one sheet face down, her hand flat on it. Middle distance: a mug gone cold, a post bag. Background: a wall clock, a window. Desk lamp, close.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at the steel desk. Foreground: a ring binder open to a clean page, a rubber stamp, a tin of paperclips. Middle distance: the chart ring. Background: the corridor, the end window. Morning light.

A council-house kitchen in the afternoon. Foreground: a wooden chair pushed under a window frame, a metal restrictor catch on the frame. Middle distance: the sink, a worktop, a tea towel. Background: a small yard and a bin through the glass. Low sun across the floor.

Bastien, a man of fifty-eight with a grey moustache, the matron, at the steel desk. Foreground: the bottom drawer open, four pads in his hands going into a cardboard box. Middle distance: the desk, the strip light, a stripped bunk. Background: the corridor, the open door. Strip light, and daylight down the corridor.

Kiyo, a nurse of twenty-three, dark hair in a low bun, teal scrubs under a grey cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, at the desk. Foreground: her hand pushing a pad back behind the spare forms. Middle distance: the open drawer, the desk lamp. Background: eleven hooks, the end window. The desk lamp on the drawer.
